the preoptic area is an important site of regulation of GnRH mRNA expression by gonadotrophic steroids in the adult rat.
the regulation of cellular levels of preoptic GnRH mRNA expression by gonadotrophins and gonadal steroids occurs in a highly specific manner.
GnRH mRNA is expressed at higher levels in the preoptic area of the long-term, castrated rat than in intact animals, and that this is due to an estrogen receptor-mediated mechanism.
